issue.title: Track Firefox Dag Calendar tooltip e2e flake
issue.body:
The Firefox PROD-image UI e2e job repeatedly times out in Dag Calendar tooltip tests while waiting for `calendar-tooltip` to appear. This reproduced across multiple PR runs for apache/airflow#67818, including after moving the test hover to the `BasicTooltip` trigger wrapper.

Affected tests:

- `tests/e2e/specs/dag-calendar-tab.spec.ts:43` - verify manual runs are detected
- `tests/e2e/specs/dag-calendar-tab.spec.ts:51` - verify hover shows correct run states
- `tests/e2e/specs/dag-calendar-tab.spec.ts:60` - failed filter shows only failed runs

Workaround being applied: mark these Dag Calendar tooltip-state assertions as Firefox-only `fixme` tests so unrelated PRs are not blocked by the Firefox hover flake.

Follow-up work:

- Make Dag Calendar tooltip interaction deterministic in Firefox PROD-image e2e runs, or replace the fragile hover-dependent assertion with a stable user-observable signal.
- Remove the Firefox-only `fixme` annotations once the tooltip-state assertions are reliable.
- Confirm the full Firefox UI e2e PROD-image job passes after re-enabling the tests.

---
Drafted-by: Codex (GPT-5) (no human review before posting)

comments.body: Can you please add it to the https://github.com/orgs/apache/projects/403 where we keep flaky stuff?

Thanks, that makes sense. I opened #67869 to track the Firefox Dag Calendar UI e2e flake while the workaround was being discussed, but I agree the better path is a direct fix once the failure mode is understood.

I'll treat #67879 as the canonical fix and close #67869 once that fix lands. I also tried to add #67869 to Apache Project 403, but my current GitHub token is missing `read:project`; could a maintainer or project admin add it while the issue remains open?

For future fix-imminent flakes, I'll go straight to a PR instead of opening a separate tracking issue.
